name: neuroflow
description: A Claude Code plugin for neuroscience research — from hypothesis to publication, with project memory, research-integrity rules, and an optional mod for live project views and guard-rails. Supports EEG, iEEG, fMRI, eye tracking, ECG and other modalities.

runtime.title: neuroflow mod
runtime.description: off: the mod does nothing. observe: views, status and warnings only. on: also fills bookkeeping gaps and may enforce guards.

guards.title: Guards
guards.description: warn: say what a guard would block. enforce: deny (only with the mod set to on).

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: off, quiet (only what needs attention), or normal.

citations.title: Citation checks
citations.description: After the model writes a manuscript, grant, poster or report, check that its new DOIs resolve; re-check notices weekly. Needs runtime on.
